justification: One matching condition in the function that picks which council's DCP a lot gets; it changes served data for North Sydney lots, so standard not minor.

pre_impl.existing_data: dcp_setback_controls rows keyed by lga slug; no rows are changed
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: A truncated plan name that used to match by containment now resolves to None and shows 'DCP not onboarded' instead of controls, which is visible and safe
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Applies to every new brief, conveyancing and upzoning call; cached reports keep the old controls until regenerated

functions.name: detect_former_council
functions.input: the property address string and the zone EPI name from the planning portal
functions.output: the council slug used to fetch DCP controls, or None when not onboarded
functions.if_none: None means the report says the council's DCP is not onboarded; an empty EPI still resolves to None

break_it.scenario: A plan name contains another council's key (North Sydney contains Sydney)
break_it.what_happens: The lot is served the wrong council's DCP under that council's name

break_it.scenario: A correct EPI string with leading whitespace or odd case stops matching
break_it.what_happens: A covered council would show 'DCP not onboarded'
break_it.how: the EPI is upper-cased and stripped before the startswith test; test_every_key_resolves_to_itself covers every key

break_it.scenario: A generic or partial plan name (LOCAL ENVIRONMENTAL PLAN, SYDNEY) is contained in many keys
break_it.what_happens: The first council in the table would be served for the lot
break_it.how: the old 'name contained in key' fallback is removed; only startswith matches; test_a_generic_or_partial_plan_name_resolves_to_no_council (found by the Sol cross-review)

falsifiable_check.fails_when: North Sydney's plan name, or a generic or partial name, resolves to any council, or a table key stops matching its own council
falsifiable_check.observed_red: With the original function restored, 2 of the new tests failed (north sydney and the every-key test) and 32 passed; with the fix, 34 passed

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes: run Site Facts for 74 Hayberry Street, Crows Nest after the Railway deploy and confirm no City Of Sydney DCP
